```{r, echo=FALSE}
ice_df_table <- ice_df

# Change n/a values to "-"
ice_df_table$Age[is.na(ice_df_table$Age)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$State[is.na(ice_df_table$State)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$City[is.na(ice_df_table$City)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$County[is.na(ice_df_table$County)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Official)`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Official)`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Facilities & Transfers`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Facilities & Transfers`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Other Notes`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Other Notes`)] <- "-"

# Drop Drive Link to Sources Column
ice_df_table <- ice_df_table %>% select(-`Drive Link to Sources`)

```


```{r}
#| echo: false

library(reactable)
library(htmltools)


# Helper function for long text cells
long_text <- function(value, preview_length = 65) {

  value <- as.character(value)

  if (length(value) == 0 || is.na(value) || value == "") {
    return("")
  }

  preview <- if (nchar(value) > preview_length) {
    paste0(substr(value, 1, preview_length), "...")
  } else {
    value
  }

  tags$span(
    title = value,
    preview
  )
}


# REactable

reactable(

  ice_df_table,

  class = "my-table",
  fullWidth = TRUE,
  bordered = FALSE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  compact = FALSE,
  resizable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  paginationType = "jump",

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    align = "left",
    headerStyle = list(fontWeight = "700")
  ),

  columns = list(

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Basic information
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    `Name` = colDef(minWidth = 180, width = 220),
    `Date` = colDef(minWidth = 100, width = 110),
    `Age` = colDef(minWidth = 60, width = 70, align = "center"),
    `Gender` = colDef(minWidth = 90, width = 100),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Location
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    `Location` = colDef(minWidth = 150, width = 190),
    `Country` = colDef(minWidth = 100, width = 120),
    `State` = colDef(minWidth = 90, width = 105),
    `City` = colDef(minWidth = 120, width = 145),
    `County` = colDef(minWidth = 120, width = 145),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Geographic coordinates
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    `Latitude` = colDef(minWidth = 100, width = 110),
    `Longitude` = colDef(minWidth = 100, width = 110),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Custody
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    `Custody` = colDef(minWidth = 120, width = 140),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # LONG TEXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    `Cause of Death (Official)` = colDef(
      minWidth = 220,
      width = 270,
      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(value, 65)
      }
    ),

    `Cause of Death (Unofficial)` = colDef(
      minWidth = 220,
      width = 270,
      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(value, 65)
      }
    ),

    `Facilities & Transfers` = colDef(
      minWidth = 240,
      width = 300,
      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(value, 65)
      }
    ),
    
    `Other Notes` = colDef(
      minWidth = 240,
      width = 300,
      cell = function(value) {
        long_text(value, 65)
      }
    )
  )
)
```
